value.rationale: The conjugacy-class number is a standard finite-group invariant. The formula unifies every connected unicyclic height-two incidence algebra over all finite fields, shows attachment-shape independence, and proves that group order plus class number recover cycle length for q>2. It is a structurally motivated complete classification, not a small numerical slice.
